name: Coffee
source:
Half-awake, you pull the covers over your shoulders, ready for just a few more minutes of sleep. A sudden chill crawls up your spine. Your wife hums in the kitchen, oblivious, making coffee. Seeing her so carefree makes you smile, yet something about the moment feels wrong.
